items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: not that I knew him but I know him now

ctx.x: Oh no kidding. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-

Spent all day — not that I knew him but I know him now. He’s been, you may know, a professor at Berklee all these years since then except he retired maybe four years ago, but still got it and lots of stories you can possibly imagine. But that started to hit me all of a sudden this horns, horns in rock & roll and how they opened up the stricture, you know the narrow strictures of rock & roll which were just you couldn’t play more than four chords or we don’t want to hear from you, and you certainly couldn’t play a…
